title: Guest Review Rating Leaderboard
dataSources: Airbnb bookings (`airbnb:booking`), Vrbo reservations (`vrbo:reservation`), Airbnb payouts (`airbnb:payout`), and guest reviews (`guest:review`).
app: Airbnb booking exports, Vrbo reservation webhooks, Airbnb payout statements, guest review logs, and turnover checklists streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=guest:review rating=*
| stats sum(rating) as total_value, avg(rating) as avg_value by listing_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks listing values by total and average rating across guest review events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `rating` values for each guest review event and review total and average rating by listing.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total rating.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which listing shows the biggest rating numbers in your guest review data.
